name: seal-manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import os,json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,datetime
excl=['MANIFEST.json','seal-manifest.receipt.json','seal-manifest.output.txt']
rows=[]
for r,d,f in os.walk('.'):
    d.sort()
    for x in sorted(f):
        p=os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,x),'.')
        if p in excl: continue
        b=open(p,'rb').read()
        rows.append({'path':p,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
rows.sort(key=lambda z:z['path'])
receipts=[z['path'] for z in rows if z['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')]
exits={p[:-len('.receipt.json')]:json.load(open(p))['exit'] for p in receipts}
nz={k:v for k,v in exits.items() if v!=0}
print('files',len(rows),'receipts',len(receipts),'nonzero',nz)
print('chunk07-10',{k:exits[k] for k in ['denials-chunk-07','denials-chunk-08','denials-chunk-09','denials-chunk-10']})
print('all 21 denial chunks present',all(('denials-chunk-%02d'%i) in exits for i in range(21)))
led=[json.loads(l) for l in open('guard-ledger.jsonl')]
print('ledger',[(e['event'],e.get('status'),e.get('url')) for e in led])
print('budget',json.load(open('search-budget.json')))
for need in ['REVIEW.md','PROOF.md','PROOF-ADDENDUM.md','PROCESS-NOTE.md','source-map.json','review.json','frozen-after.json','search-responses/search-1.full.txt','search-responses/search-2.full.txt']:
    print(need,os.path.exists(need))
m={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'target':368315,'scope':'exhaustive own-lane byte manifest','terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions':excl,'exclusion_reason':'MANIFEST.json cannot contain its own hash; the two seal-manifest runner products are written by run.py after this child exits','file_count':len(rows),'files':rows}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','write_lane.py','MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(m,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10)
print('manifest write',z.returncode,z.stderr)
sys.exit(z.returncode)
